dogecoin.text: $DOGE’s popularity spawned more dog-themed meme coins like @ShibainuCoin, @RealFlokiInu, @safemoon, reaching high valuations quickly.

The “GME” craze sparked speculation in other assets, especially those on Robinhood.

$DOGE, listed on Robinhood in 2018 at $0.008, gained massive attention in 2021 due to @elonmusk’s tweets, peaking at a market value of $90 billion in May 2021. https://t.co/Yhml1J7ksM

History of Memecoins:

From $DOGE to $SHIB, $PEPE, & $WIF, memecoins share a combined market cap of $65 billion today. It all started in the summer of 2013 with @dogecoin. Dogecoin’s success birthed the meme coin species, and the unstoppable force of memecoins was set in motion. https://t.co/qROBmziL2v
